_comment: Reference example — copy values into loop.config.json and edit. Every field is documented inline below. Optional fields may be null; Ship degrades gracefully (no headroom signal => the Bosun paces by heat anyway; no validator => the reconcile step is a no-op).
_ship_root: Absolute path to your ship directory (queue.md, captain.md, projects/, logs/, state/). The skills + scripts resolve ship paths from here. '.' means the current working directory.
_repos: The repos crew work in. Used for the preflight git-status sweep and the Bosun's curate sweep. Empty list is valid.
_max_concurrent_crew: Cap on simultaneously-dispatched crew (a flat default). Rate-aware dispatch bands are a module on top.
_github_org: Org for PR links + the Bosun's curate sweep (gh pr list / search scoped here).
_chat_surface: Where directives arrive that should WAKE the Mate (vs. batch). classify_input.py decides wake-vs-batch; the wake-monitor (wake_monitor.py) watches this + inbox/drops/. The Bosun also writes wake-class drops into inbox/drops/.
_validator_cmd: Optional command run at the Mate's reconcile step + the Bosun's reconcile. Exit 0 / a parseable RESULT line for CLEAN. Absent => reconcile is a no-op, validator reported 'NONE'.
_agents: The custom subagent defs shipkit installs (the two role agents from modules/autonomous/agents/, the workers from core/agents/) into install_target, substituting {SHIP_DIR} in each def's hook command paths with ship_root. ship-mate + ship-bosun are the long-running role agents; the rest are dispatched workers.
_hooks: The bright-line PreToolUse hooks (paths relative to ship_root). EVERY hook MUST be executable (chmod +x) — a non-exec hook fails OPEN (silent zero enforcement). shipkit-init + ship-up.sh set/self-heal the bit. Each ships a generic core + a per-deployment override block (mate_bash) or a *-allow-local.sh extension (crew/bosun).
_launch: ship-up.sh / launch-bosun.sh settings. The Mate boots EVENT-DRIVEN via mate_prompt (NOT /loop); the Bosun owns the heartbeat via bosun_prompt. sandbox_wrapper: running the agent in a sandbox is RECOMMENDED (defense-in-depth). On macOS, agent-safehouse.dev is a good option — point this at its wrapper; absent => bare 'claude' (no sandbox). MCP configs are optional (PR-1 can run empty-MCP); set SHIP_MATE_MCP / BOSUN_MCP env to override.
_headroom_signal_path: Optional. The dispatch-bands module reads this for rate-aware crew-cap modulation. The Mate does NOT wind down on it (event-driven, no loop to gate) and the Bosun paces by heat — so absent is fine.
_hosts_ports: Optional. Only used by UI/status-surface modules. Leave null for a headless ship.
